processors.name: logical_cpus
processors.note: what the OS reports, which on a VPS is what the hypervisor presents and not necessarily what is contended for

processors.name: cpus_available_to_this_process
processors.note: absent on Windows; where it differs from the count above, the difference is the part of the machine this process may not use

processors.name: load_average_1m
processors.note: absent on Windows. This is the single most important unmeasurable on the owner's host: without it, CPU pressure from MetaTrader 5 cannot be observed and the owner's CPU share is honoured by limiting workers instead of by sampling

processors.name: cpu_percent_used
processors.note: not available from the standard library on any platform, and psutil is not installed; reported unmeasurable rather than estimated

memory.name: memory_available_bytes
memory.note: what is free for DeskPilot *and* for MetaTrader 5; it is not headroom DeskPilot may take

memory.name: memory_used_by_metatrader
memory.note: not observable without enumerating another application's processes, which this system does not do on a machine it is a guest on

disk.name: disk_free_bytes
disk.note: the floor in `solvent setup capacity --min-free-disk-bytes` should leave room for MetaTrader 5's own files, not just DeskPilot's

disk.name: disk_io_throughput
disk.note: not measurable without writing a benchmark file to the owner's disk, which this does not do uninvited

deskpilot.name: deskpilot_peak_rss_bytes
deskpilot.note: this interpreter only, and `resource` does not exist on Windows

network.name: outbound_policy
network.note: DeskPilot makes no outbound request outside an Action Gate window; the allowlist is the policy's, not this tool's

network.name: bandwidth_limit
network.note: the host states none and this does not measure it by saturating the owner's link

note: nothing here is inferred from the monthly cost; a price is a billing fact and not a core count
